author: The Infographics Show
description:
What if the world’s biggest pyramid isn’t in Egypt, but hidden in Europe?

In Bosnia, near the town of Visoko, a group of massive hills has sparked one of the most controversial archaeological debates in modern history.
Some claim they are ancient pyramids, larger than the Great Pyramid of Giza, and possibly tens of thousands of years old.
Others argue they are simply natural formations shaped by erosion over time.

At the center of the mystery is Semir Osmanagić, the man who transformed this quiet valley into a global phenomenon.

So is this a hidden civilization, or one of the biggest archaeological controversies ever?
